goldens.comment: The code uses Error log level for what appears to be debugging information. This will pollute error logs in production. Consider using Debug or Info level instead.
goldens.reasoning: C1 points out that debugging information is logged at Error level and will flood production error logs.

goldens.comment: The cleanup job ticker was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, which can lead to increased database load and contention due to more frequent execution of cleanup tasks. This change should be reviewed to ensure it aligns with performance expectations.
goldens.reasoning: C2 points out that the cleanup ticker was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, which makes cleanup run more often.

candidates: Annotation cleanup logs at Error level on the success path and prints full ID batches and SQL conditions, which can flood production error logs and become expensive with large batch sizes

The global cleanup loop ticker was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, increasing how often all cleanup tasks run and contradicting existing documentation that states temp CSV/PNG cleanup runs every 10 minutes
The new split SELECT+DELETE approach can still share the same DB session/transaction when the context already contains a session, undermining the stated goal of letting locks flush between statements
Integration test registers t.Cleanup after data creation and fatal assertions, so a failure in setup/assertions can leave tables dirty and break later subtests that reuse the same DB handle
